name: agenterr
description: Investigate production errors and logs from your editor. Connects Claude Code to a self-hosted Agenterr server over MCP — 21 tools plus a debugging workflow skill.

server_url.title: Agenterr server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your Agenterr server, with no trailing slash. A local instance is http://localhost:3617.

api_key.title: Agenterr API key
api_key.description: An agt_api_... key for the project you want to read. Mint one with POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/keys. An admin key also works, but it grants instance-wide access.
